title: GCash celebrates 22nd birthday with nationwide ‘pasalamat’ blowout
summary: Birthdays are often about sharing what you have, whether it is food for family and friends, a free treat for someone who needs it, or a little something for everyone who helped make another year…

blocks.text: Birthdays are often about sharing what you have, whether it is food for family and friends, a free treat for someone who needs it, or a little something for everyone who helped make another year worth celebrating. For its 22nd birthday, GCash is bringing that familiar Filipino tradition to life through a nationwide ‘pasalamat’ birthday blowout for the Filipinos who have been part of its journey. From October 20 to 31, the celebration will bring pakain, palibre, and pamigay to everyday Filipino moments, from the morning commute and merienda to everyday transactions that can unlock birthday surprises.
